name: askdock-transcript-row
description: the questions widget is the transcript's trailing row inside the real VirtualList scroll hierarchy: it sizes to its content (no internal scroll), centers on the 76rem reading measure, and leaves the transcript's allocation and the footer untouched however tall the batch - the virtual list's root alone scrolls

mutation.declaration: widgets/virtuallist/virtuallist.module.css: .root { overflow-y: auto } (the production transcript's actual scroll owner) - without it the tall batch overflows unscrollably instead of scrolling inside the virtual list
mutation.note: Verified by hand: reverting to overflow-y: visible fails the case with 'transcript overflow belongs to visible, not the virtual list's root'. The first version of this case mutation-tested panescaffold's .body overflow instead - roborev PR #854 correctly flagged that .body never scrolls in the session pane (the VirtualList root does), so the harness now mirrors the full .body > .transcript > .transcriptContent > .transcriptList > .root chain.
